question: How many of the banned cards are white border?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "banned_cards_all" AS SELECT t1.id, t1.bordercolor
FROM table_1 AS t1
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(REPLACE(id, '"', '') AS BIGINT) AS id
  FROM table_2
  WHERE value ILIKE 'banned'
) AS b
ON t1.id = b.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS white_border_banned_count
FROM banned_cards_all
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(bordercolor, '')) = 'white';
